measurable_change.description: St. Columba Ecumenical Ministries in Norfolk has temporarily closed its food pantry because of damage from a broken pipe. The provider says it hopes to reopen in early September. The pantry normally supplies households with up to three days of food and allows assistance once every 30 days.
